description:
crates/gf2-core/src/gf2m/wide_config.rs:22 claims the implicit-leading-bit convention matches Gf2mField_::new, but that carrier stores the leading term explicitly (BinaryPrimeExt::new in field/extension.rs now depends on the explicit form). Fix the comment to state the actual convention.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The wide_config.rs convention comment states the explicit-leading-term behavior consistent with Gf2mField_::new and the extension-trait usage, verified against the code.
title: wide_config.rs comment misstates the leading-term convention
